_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Frost Bite#001.src: Are you here to cross the Great Bridge as well?

Frost Bite#002.src: I fear you'll have to wait, the warning wasn't without merit.

Frost Bite#003.src: The {p} military has issued an official warning to all travelers wishing to cross the Great Bridge.

Frost Bite#004.src: No one should use the bridge until they have dealt with the... underlying issue.

Frost Bite#005.src: I ignored the warning at first, since the bridge is the only path into the jungle...

Frost Bite#006.src: But attempting to cross the bridge proved unbearable. Even out here, can't you feel that intense heat?

Frost Bite#007.src: I wouldn't blame anyone for not wanting to venture further, let alone meet whatever is causing this heat!

Frost Bite#008.src: And so I've been waiting here with my assistant all day... We're potion makers, you see, and we were headed to the grand city of {p} to sell supplies.

Frost Bite#009.src: If you want to ignore the military's warning, I suppose you might benefit from buying some our stock first. Our potions are stronger than any sold in {p}, after all!

Frost Bite#010.src: From the look of your equipment... I'd say you might have a better chance of making it across than us.

Frost Bite#011.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up and take a look at the drill, would you?

Frost Bite#012.src: Now you've obtained the key, you can enter Theoricks mansion

Frost Bite#013.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, I have a carriage for it.

Frost Bite#014.src: Sir Theorick, if you, um...if you have a moment? Your tribute is here...

Frost Bite#015.src: ...good. Thank you. Good to see some who honestly respect what I'm trying to do for all of you. Was there anyone else?

Frost Bite#016.src: Ah...no. There...there wasn't. Not this time. They feel like you're taking too much from them, which I don't agree with, but-

Frost Bite#017.src: ...ask them, if they would prefer their money, or their lives. Am I not protecting them? Is it really so much to ask that I get something in return?

Frost Bite#018.src: We...we know. We told them that, too...we're sorry.

Frost Bite#019.src: You aren't the ones who need to apologize! I'm aware it's a voluntary contribution, but do they have any idea how difficult it is to cast magic like this regularly?!

Frost Bite#020.src: This is unbeliveable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.

Frost Bite#021.src: There must be some way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.

Frost Bite#022.src: Wow, even by todays standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.

Frost Bite#023.src: Find Eppo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The entrance to his cave can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Frost Bite#026.src: Darn. The drill just won't start.
Frost Bite#026.dst: 可恶。钻机就是启动不了。
Frost Bite#026.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#027.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up here to the drill, maybe you can take a look?
Frost Bite#027.dst: 嘿，守卫！你懂电磁魔法吗？上来钻机这边，也许你能看看？
Frost Bite#027.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#028.src: Oh! Never mind, it lit up, back up!
Frost Bite#028.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#029.src: For the love of Bob... Why won't you just break?
Frost Bite#029.dst: 看在 Bob 的份上……你为什么就是不碎？
Frost Bite#029.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#030.src: This ice was created by Theorick, a Twain who defended this area many many years ago.
Frost Bite#030.dst: 这冰是 Theorick 造出来的，他是很多很多年前守护这一带的一位 Twain。
Frost Bite#030.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#031.src: When the corruption got too much... He froze everything, including the people. Do you see them in there?
Frost Bite#031.dst: 当腐化变得太严重时……他把一切都冻住了，包括人。你看到里面的他们了吗？
Frost Bite#031.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#032.src: We've tried desperately to get them out, but we've tried all the equipment we had, including this Corkian drill.
Frost Bite#032.dst: 我们拼命想把他们弄出来，可我们所有的设备都试过了，包括这台 Corkus 钻机。
Frost Bite#032.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#033.src: Maybe we should get more destructive... The demolition expert, Rhudya, is further down the cave.
Frost Bite#033.dst: 也许我们该用更有破坏力的东西……爆破专家 Rhudya 就在洞窟更深处。
Frost Bite#033.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#034.src: It's a long shot, but worth a try. Would you be able to get it while I clear this space?
Frost Bite#034.dst: 希望不大，但值得一试。我清理这块地方的时候，你能去拿来吗？
Frost Bite#034.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#035.src: Go deeper into the cave and speak to Rhudya.
Frost Bite#035.dst: 深入洞窟，与 Rhudya 交谈。

Frost Bite#036.src: Whup! You're on private property, y'know! Oh, Eppo sent ya? That's fair enough.
Frost Bite#036.dst: 嚯！你闯进私人地盘了，知道吧！噢，是 Eppo 叫你来的？那就没问题。
Frost Bite#036.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#037.src: You'll be needing this TNT then, make sure not to drop it though, whup!
Frost Bite#037.dst: 那你需要这包 TNT，可千万别掉了，嚯！
Frost Bite#037.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#038.src: Just travel through this cave and you'll be returned to Eppo easy-peasy!
Frost Bite#038.dst: 穿过这个洞窟，你就能轻轻松松回到 Eppo 那里！
Frost Bite#038.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#039.src: Return to Eppo with the tnt.
Frost Bite#039.dst: 带着 TNT 回到 Eppo 那里。

Frost Bite#040.src: Very nice, this might do the trick.
Frost Bite#040.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#041.src: Back up, I'll ignite the explosive.
Frost Bite#041.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#043.src: NOTHING? Not even a scratch. I don't understand Theoricks ice.. It's not real.
Frost Bite#043.dst: 一点用都没有？连个刮痕都没有。我搞不懂 Theorick 的冰.. 它不是真的冰。
Frost Bite#043.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#044.src: I'm not sure what else we can do then...
Frost Bite#044.dst: 那我也不知道还能怎么办了……
Frost Bite#044.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#045.src: HEY. Eppo, over here! Near the cave!
Frost Bite#045.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#046.src: Did the explosive not work? I found this old mineshaft on the way back from the cave, it leads to an old lava cavern.
Frost Bite#046.dst: 炸药没用吗？我从洞窟回来的路上发现了一条旧矿井，它通往一个旧熔岩洞。
Frost Bite#046.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#047.src: Might be a long shot, but this lava looks different. Why not give it a try?
Frost Bite#047.dst: 希望也许不大，但那里的熔岩看起来不太一样。何不试试看？
Frost Bite#047.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#048.src: Travel to the lava springs through the mineshaft.

Frost Bite#049.src: Complete the puzzle and bring the lava back to Eppo.
Frost Bite#049.dst: 解开谜题，把熔岩带回给 Eppo。

Frost Bite#050.src: I don't understand how you can hold lava in a bucket.. But here we are.
Frost Bite#050.dst: 我搞不懂你是怎么用桶装熔岩的.. 不过总之拿来了。
Frost Bite#050.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#051.src: Truth is.. We're not retrieving these bodies for no reason.
Frost Bite#051.dst: 老实说.. 我们不是无缘无故要取回这些遗体的。
Frost Bite#051.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#052.src: We believe one of these people worked for Theorick, and has a key to his mansion
Frost Bite#052.dst: 我们相信这些人里有一个替 Theorick 做事，身上有他宅邸的钥匙
Frost Bite#052.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#053.src: We in {p} think Theorick has a lot to answer for. We want to redistribute his wealth among those he hurt.
Frost Bite#053.dst: 我们 {p} 的人认为 Theorick 有很多账要算。我们想把他的财富重新分给那些被他伤害的人。
Frost Bite#053.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#054.src: Right, I've dipped this stick in the magical lava. Just hold the rod and walk into the ice to melt it.
Frost Bite#054.dst: 好了，我已经把这根棍子浸过魔法熔岩了。握着棍子走进冰里就能融化它。
Frost Bite#054.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#055.src: Look for the corpse with a key, it might be above you. Good luck!
Frost Bite#055.dst: 找那具带着钥匙的尸体，可能在你上方。祝你好运！
Frost Bite#055.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#056.src: Melt the ice and find the Servant's corpse.
Frost Bite#056.dst: 融化冰块，找到仆人的尸体。

Frost Bite#057.src: Is that the right one? You got it? Brilliant! Now come back down.
Frost Bite#057.dst: 是那一具吗？你拿到了？太棒了！现在下来吧。
Frost Bite#057.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#058.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, lets take my horse.
Frost Bite#058.dst: 我们一起去宅邸吧。来，骑我的马。
Frost Bite#058.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#059.src: While we ride, let me explain a little more about what we're doing. Let's go.
Frost Bite#059.dst: 路上我再多跟你讲讲我们在做的事。走吧。
Frost Bite#059.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#060.src: As I mentioned before, there is a reason this land is frozen, and it's not natural.
Frost Bite#060.dst: 我之前说过，这片土地被冻住是有原因的，而且不是自然形成的。
Frost Bite#060.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#061.src: Many years before Bob was around, Wynn was in ruins due to the corruption war.
Frost Bite#061.dst: 在 Bob 出现的很多年前，Wynn 因为腐化战争而一片废墟。
Frost Bite#061.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#062.src: In those times there used to be a group of naturally gifted individuals called the Twains. They defended us all with elemental magic.
Frost Bite#062.dst: 那个年代有一群天赋异禀的人，叫作 Twain。他们用元素魔法保护着我们所有人。
Frost Bite#062.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#063.src: Theorick was one of those Twains. He harnessed unnaturally powerful ice based magic. He used it to protect the land surrounding the mansion.
Frost Bite#063.dst: Theorick 就是其中一位 Twain。他掌握着强大到不自然的冰系魔法，用来保护宅邸周围的土地。
Frost Bite#063.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#064.src: Theorick.. Wasn't like the other Twains. He wanted the people he protected to pay and feed him as way of thanks.
Frost Bite#064.dst: Theorick.. 跟其他 Twain 不一样。他要他保护的人付钱、养活他，作为谢礼。
Frost Bite#064.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#065.src: After years, Theorick was rich while the people he protected lived in poverty and fear - not only of the monsters, but in fear of Theorick himself.
Frost Bite#065.dst: 几年过去，Theorick 富了，而他保护的人却活在贫困与恐惧之中——不只怕怪物，也怕 Theorick 本人。
Frost Bite#065.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#066.src: He punished those who disobeyed his curfews and would get angry if anyone tried to move away. The people felt trapped.
Frost Bite#066.dst: 他惩罚违反他宵禁令的人，谁想搬走他就发火。人们觉得自己被困住了。
Frost Bite#066.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#067.src: Eventually, just like the other Twains - Theorick fell to the corruption. Not before he had the last word.
Frost Bite#067.dst: 最后，就跟其他 Twain 一样——Theorick 也被腐化吞噬了。但在那之前，他留下了最后的一手。
Frost Bite#067.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#068.src: He froze the land entirely, killing almost everything and everyone left outside in it. Hundreds of lives were lost.
Frost Bite#068.dst: 他把整片土地冻住，几乎杀死了留在外面的一切。数百条生命就此逝去。
Frost Bite#068.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#069.src: It turns out the ice slowed the spread of corruption across the land to almost a standstill. It's been this way ever since.
Frost Bite#069.dst: 结果冰让腐化在这片土地上的蔓延几乎停滞了。从那以后就一直是这样。
Frost Bite#069.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#070.src: Now that we can get in his mansion we hope to uncover the secrets of his ice magic so we may undo it, and share the wealth he hoarded from the people. Ah, we're here.
Frost Bite#070.dst: 现在我们能进他的宅邸了，希望能揭开他冰魔法的秘密，好把它解除，再把他从人们身上搜刮来的财富分出去。啊，我们到了。
Frost Bite#070.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#072.src: This place looks frozen in time.. The grandure.. Well he did just take and take from everyone around him.
Frost Bite#072.dst: 这地方看起来像时间被冻结了.. 这么富丽堂皇.. 好吧，他就是一直从身边的人那里拿了又拿。
Frost Bite#072.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#073.src: So, I'm not sure where to start, but I'm guessing he has some protection in place.
Frost Bite#073.dst: 那么，我不确定该从哪里开始，不过我猜他设了一些防护措施。
Frost Bite#073.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#074.src: This is unbelievable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.
Frost Bite#074.dst: 真令人难以置信.. 他真是个贪婪的——啊啊啊啊。
Frost Bite#074.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#075.src: ... I don't think we should insult him..
Frost Bite#075.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#076.src: Find the riches in Theorick's mansion.
Frost Bite#076.dst: 在 Theorick 的宅邸里找到财宝。

Frost Bite#077.src: Oof! Wasn't expecting that. That just proves everything I said about him. Punishing people who insult him.
Frost Bite#077.dst: 哎哟！没想到会这样。这正好证明了我说的他的一切。惩罚骂他的人。
Frost Bite#077.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#078.src: Anyway, we should look around for some kind of secret entrance.
Frost Bite#078.dst: 总之，我们应该四处找找有没有什么秘密入口。
Frost Bite#078.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#079.src: Trust Theorick to booby trap his own house the paranoid frozen gro-
Frost Bite#079.dst: 果然是 Theorick，连自己家都设陷阱，这个多疑的冰冻老——
Frost Bite#079.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#080.src: That really isn't fun at all. I can't see a thing. Where are we now, a dead end?
Frost Bite#080.dst: 这可一点都不好玩。我什么都看不见。我们现在在哪，死路吗？
Frost Bite#080.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#081.src: Well we know that insults result in punishment. Maybe a compliment will make him happy?
Frost Bite#081.dst: 好吧，我们知道骂他会受惩罚。也许夸他会让他高兴？
Frost Bite#081.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#082.src: Oh Theorick, strongest of all the Twains, you really are a hero.
Frost Bite#082.dst: 噢 Theorick，所有 Twain 中最强大的，你真是位英雄。
Frost Bite#082.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#084.src: Looks like we finally found his private quarters, look at that vault door.
Frost Bite#084.dst: 看来我们终于找到他的私人房间了，看那扇金库门。
Frost Bite#084.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#085.src: There must be a way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.
Frost Bite#085.dst: 一定有办法打开它。四处看看你能找到什么。
Frost Bite#085.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#086.src: Find your way into the vault.

Frost Bite#087.src: You did it! We have access to the vault.
Frost Bite#087.dst: 你办到了！我们能进金库了。
Frost Bite#087.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#088.src: Wow, even by today's standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
Frost Bite#088.dst: 哇，就算以今天的标准来看，这也是一大笔钱。想想几百年前这得值多少。
Frost Bite#088.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#089.src: Grab a little for yourself, too, we wouldn't have been able to get here without you.
Frost Bite#089.dst: 你自己也拿一点吧，没有你我们到不了这里。
Frost Bite#089.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#090.src: Wait, look at this. It seems to be a piece of Theoricks armour.
Frost Bite#090.dst: 等等，你看这个。好像是 Theorick 的一件护甲。
Frost Bite#090.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#091.src: Surprised it even managed to fit over his fat head.
Frost Bite#091.dst: 真意外这东西竟然套得进他那颗大胖头。
Frost Bite#091.speaker: Eppo
